n3ac9ca35a0.headline: AMLO blames Pemex deficit on FCH and EPN
n3ac9ca35a0.summary: Mexican President Andrés Manuel López Obrador attributed Pemex's crude oil production deficit affecting its finances to the administrations of Felipe Calderón and Enrique Peña Nieto.
n3ac9ca35a0.why: Pemex is Mexico's state oil company, critical to the country's economy; production deficits impact fiscal revenues and energy sector stability.

n47ddbd2d79.headline: Venezuelan Government Reportedly Overpaid USD 206 Million in Food Imports
n47ddbd2d79.summary: Reports allege Venezuela overpaid USD 206 million in food imports, with the vice president reportedly involved in collecting overpricing in the food distribution system.
n47ddbd2d79.why: Import overpricing diverts public funds and affects food supply costs, which bears on Venezuela's fiscal position and sovereign credit risk.
